warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.

annotation.organism: Paraburkholderia phymatum (strain DSM 17167 / CIP 108236 / LMG 21445 / STM815)
function: Catalyzes the conversion of acetate into acetyl-CoA (AcCoA), an essential intermediate at the junction of anabolic and catabolic pathways. AcsA undergoes a two-step reaction. In the first half reaction, AcsA combines acetate with ATP to form acetyl-adenylate (AcAMP) intermediate. In the second half reaction, it can then transfer the acetyl group from AcAMP to the sulfhydryl group of CoA, forming the product AcCoA.

catalytic_activity.equation: acetate + ATP + CoA = acetyl-CoA + AMP + diphosphate
